name: Hummus
assumptions: Yield estimated at 4 side-dish servings based on standard hummus recipes using one 400g can of chickpeas
Total preparation time estimated at 10 minutes from quick blending and mixing steps with no cooking
Greek yogurt confirms presence of milk (dairy) and makes it non-vegan
No wheat, eggs, fish, shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts or soy ingredients listed
All ingredients are compatible with vegetarian and pescatarian diets
Gluten-free classification based on absence of barley, rye, wheat or uncertified oats
instructions:
step 1
Drain the chickpeas into a sieve set over a bowl or jug to catch the liquid. Tip the chickpeas, tahini, garlic and yogurt into a food processor or blender and whizz to smooth.

step 2
Whizz in a tbsp of the chickpea liquid at a time until you have a nice consistency, then scrape into a bowl.

step 3
Stir in a squeeze of lemon juice and season to taste.

ingredients.name: Chickpeas
ingredients.assumptions: Canned chickpeas, drained weight approximately 240-260g but using full 400g can contents as listed; standard drained chickpea nutrition applied to whole line

ingredients.name: Tahini Paste
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tablespoon tahini paste is approximately 15g; standard tahini values

ingredients.name: Garlic Clove
ingredients.assumptions: 1 large garlic clove is approximately 6g; standard raw garlic nutrition

ingredients.name: Greek Yogurt
ingredients.assumptions: 3 tablespoons Greek yogurt is approximately 45g; nonfat/plain Greek yogurt values

ingredients.name: Lemon
ingredients.assumptions: Juice of half a lemon is approximately 25-30ml/25g; standard lemon juice nutrition
